# LBNL: United States Data Center Energy Usage Report: 2025 Update

Published: 06/2026. Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory, Systems & Energy Technologies Analysis.

## Key Findings
- Data centers could account for **11.8% of total US electricity by 2030** (range: **9.5-15.3%**).
- Comparison: 2024 Report estimate range was 6.7-12.0% by 2028.
- **Reference Case: 649 TWh in 2030**.
- Sensitivity scenarios:
  - Lower IT equipment installations: 578 TWh
  - More specialized graphics chips: 664 TWh
  - Shorter AI chip lifetime: 590 TWh
  - Higher idle power/utilization: 782 TWh
- **Ultimate bounds: 521-843 TWh** of US data center electricity consumption in 2030.
- Method: bottom-up energy use model from real-world data on planned IT equipment shipments, per-device annual electricity use, cooling system performance simulations, facility types and locations.
